subject: Integration stitch plan, milestones, and owner cadence
messages:
From: Emma Clarke <emma@lumenhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff follow-up and MAP ask

Jordan — thanks for the demo yesterday. Ravi and I chatted after and want to lock a clear plan so our internal teams (infra, security, product) can schedule work. Can you send a compact set of milestones and owner responsibilities that we can take to our PM sync on Monday?

Key constraints on our side:
- Data ingest window: must be completed by 2026-09-17 (blocked by data ops)
- Security review: SOC audit evidence needed by 2026-09-03
- Pilot user cohort: internal clinical ops, ~12 users, target go-live 2026-10-04

If you can include any known gating risks and an initial SOW stub, that would be great.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Clarke
Head of Product Operations | Lumen Health
emma@lumenhealth.com
+1 415-222-9988

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Kickoff follow-up and MAP ask

Emma — appreciate the clarity. Attaching a first-pass integration "stitch plan" and a light SOW draft. High level below and milestone table attached (20260812_MAP-stitching-v0.1.xlsx).

Proposed compact milestones (owners and dates):
- M1: Security questionnaire submission (owner: Jordan / Redwood SE) — 2026-08-20
- M2: Evidence handover for SOC/policy (owner: Lumen Security / contact: Ravi) — 2026-09-03
- M3: Data pipeline validation (owner: Lumen Data Ops + Redwood Eng) — 2026-09-17
- M4: Pilot configuration & test cohort onboarding (owner: Monica Patel / CS) — 2026-09-24
- M5: Pilot go-live (owner: Lumen Product + Monica) — 2026-10-04
- M6: Post-pilot review & quant metrics (owner: Jordan + Ravi) — 2026-10-18

Initial gating risks we see:
- Data schema mismatch causing extra transform work (mitigation: early schema snapshot and 2-day spike)
- Third-party identity provider cert rotation window during integration (mitigation: agree maintenance window)
- Extended SOC evidence turnaround (mitigation: parallel evidence collection from our compliance pack)

Next concrete steps I propose:
1) Monica to kick off CS handoff call with Lumen ops this Friday (30 min) — Monica, can you run this?
2) Lumen to confirm security POC and share earliest evidence dates (Emma/Ravi)
3) Redwood to share an acceptance checklist for data validation by EOD Thursday

Attachment: 20260812_MAP-stitching-v0.1.xlsx (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)
Attachment: SOW-draft-Lumen-2026-08-12.pdf (redline-friendly)

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0142

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@lumenhealth.com>, Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration stitch plan, milestones, and owner cadence

Emma/Ravi — I can run the CS handoff Friday at 11:00 PT. Proposed agenda (30 min):
- Introductions + quick roles map (5 min)
- Review milestone table + acceptance criteria (10 min)
- Security evidence checklist and handover owner (5 min)
- Next 14-day sprint plan and owners (5 min)

Quick notes from CS perspective:
- Monica (CS) will own pilot onboarding and user acceptance criteria: we need 2 clinical champions and a scheduling contact from your ops team by 2026-09-01.
- Ben (solutions) will own integration validation and the runbook for cutover.
- Karthik to support AM-level escalations and commercial checkout for any scope changes during pilot.

Can you confirm the Friday slot? If yes, I will send an invite and the short 1-pager.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@lumenhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Clarke <emma@lumenhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration stitch plan, milestones, and owner cadence

Monica — Friday 11:00 PT works. Confirming Lumen owners:
- Security POC: Ravi Singh (me) — will coordinate SOC evidence; target to provide docs by 2026-09-02 (we may need two business day buffer)
- Data POC: Priya Malhotra (data ops lead) — she will run the schema snapshot; goal to deliver sample files by 2026-08-26
- Clinical champions: TBD — Emma will follow up with names by 2026-08-20

Notes: we received the SOW-draft and will circulate internally for legal redlines. If Redwood can provide the short acceptance checklist for pipeline validation before Thursday EOD, that will speed up Priya's spike.

Ravi
Ravi Singh
Director, Security & Integrations | Lumen Health
ravi.singh@lumenhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@lumenhealth.com>, Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration stitch plan, milestones, and owner cadence

All — quick logistics update post-internal:
- I will own the integration validation runbook. Deliverable: runbook + smoke test checklist by 2026-08-26.
- Proposed smoke test window: 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-10 (we will book 2-hour slots with Priya)
- Cutover dry-run: 2026-09-22 (owners: Ben + Priya + Monica)

Small ask: Emma/Ravi, can you confirm if there are maintenance blackout windows for your infra team between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-25? If yes, call them out in the Friday call so we don't schedule validation during a cert rotation or deploy freeze.

I'll send the runbook link and a calendar for the smoke test slots by Monday EOD.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
